name: Grassland Terrain
palette: Vivid hand-painted greens for grass with subtle gradient highlights, warm earth browns for soil, soft pastel flowers, painterly grey-blue stones with soft rim light.
palette_constraints: Greens for grass blades (saturated mids with brighter highlights), mid/dark browns for soil, warm yellows and pale pinks for flowers, soft grey-blue stones. NO hard 1-pixel outlines. NO chunky pixel-art aesthetic.

tile_variants.description: Solid grass top tile, short blades, flat earth fill below the grass band.
Grass tile with the left edge curving down to bare earth, for a left platform corner.
Grass tile with the right edge curving down to bare earth, for a right platform corner.
Grass tile with taller, denser blades and a few highlight tufts.
Plain packed-earth fill tile for under-grass terrain interior.
Packed-earth fill tile with embedded small pebbles and cracks.
Single yellow daisy on grass, four petals, dark green stem.
Cluster of three small pink wildflowers on grass, simple blob heads.
Single white five-petal flower with yellow center on grass.
Small clump of taller weeds on grass, three blades fanning outward.
Small grey stone resting on grass, rounded, single highlight on top-left.
Two small grey stones on grass, one slightly larger than the other.
Larger grey boulder on grass, occupying the center of the tile.
Short fallen log lying horizontally on grass, mossy patches on top.
Single red mushroom with white spots on grass.
Plain grass tile identical to grass-base, used to pad the sheet to 16 cells.
